text:
AVR_CSPM_INJECTION
Description
An
iRule event
triggered when the AVR profile
(active on the connection) is about to insert the CSPM javascript to
the response payload.
Examples
when
AVR_CSPM_INJECTION
{
if
{[
info
exist
no_cspm
]}
{
AVR
::
disable_cspm_injection
}
}
Related Information
See also:
See solution document
Overview of BIG-IP Analytics CSPM
injection
.
Available Commands:
AVR::disable_cspm_injection
- Disables the injection of CSPM javascript to the response
payload
